transcript.text: I'd like you to turn this pic of me into a professional headshot, with just a bit of tidying rather than a whole new look. I always feel a little nervous about edited portraits because I still want to recognise myself when I see the finished image. What matters most, somewhere in all of that, is that you keep my face recognisably me and don't make me younger or smooth away my skin texture. It's really just the lighting, outfit and background that I'd like you to tidy up. I'm hoping this will feel like a more polished version of the photo rather than make me feel like I'm looking at somebody else.

Your headshot is ready. Download it here (the link works for 24 hours):
https://videos.magichour.ai/cmwbg9ht700kyhb016sj2njrs/output.png?X-Goog-Algorithm=GOOG4-RSA-SHA256&X-Goog-Credential=web-service%40magic-hour-385504.iam.gserviceaccount.com%2F20261111%2Fauto%2Fstorage%2Fgoog4_request&X-Goog-Date=20261111T013816Z&X-Goog-Expires=86400&X-Goog-SignedHeaders=host&X-Goog-

I edited your own photo instead of making a new portrait. I kept the framing and asked for only three changes:
- Lighting: soft, even studio light on your face
- Outfit: a simple dark navy blazer over a plain top, in place of the grey jumper
- Background: a plain, softly blurred grey backdrop in place of the park

I also told it not to change your features, expression or age, not to smooth your skin, and to leave your curly hair as it is.

I couldn't view the result from here, so please check it closely. If anything about your face looks different from the real you, or the blazer or grey backdrop isn't right, tell me what to change and I'll redo it. On your free plan the image is 640px, and each try costs 5 credits.
transcript.why: The reply presents a finished result: a download link to the edited headshot. It adds caveats (the user should check the likeness, the link expires in 24 hours, free-plan 640px size, 5 credits per retry) and offers to redo it, but the main content is the delivered image.
